svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/tools_readme.py from the tools' docstrings and imports and the CI workflows. Tools check links, schemas and staleness; passing them is not a review and accepts nothing (rule R13).

g.text: Terms: A01–A04 = item-definition validator rule (A01–A04) · CAD = computer-aided design · CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01

to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · DoD = US Department of Defense · FreeCAD = open-source parametric CAD program used for the concept layouts · HTS = hazard tracking system (MIL-STD-882E Task 106; here safety/hazards/) ·

MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · OMG = Object Management Group, publisher of SysML · PDaC = Product Development as Code · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only

a named human review accepts anything) · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
